title: Fantastica!!
body: Che dire, app fatta benissimo, presente la lingua italiana, senza pubblicità, complimenti agli sviluppatori, avrei solo una richiesta, poter avere icona anche in modalità chiara, grazie per questa app
author: marcograz70

title: Spettacolare
body: In Italiano, gratis, senza pubblicità , con promemoria, diario, semplicissima non trovi meglio
author: TaaggMaster

title: useful app
body:
a simple, useful app that doesn’ t require you to create an account and doesn’ t put an ad every time you create a “habit” or edit it.
the app is very simple, it isn’ t overly “aesthetic” but neither boring thank to the pastel colours, which i really like. 
and by the way, there is also a timer in case you want to use it to focus on something. really great app, i love it :)
author: chrjstvpher

title: Ottima, alcuni suggerimenti
body: The app works great and it’s really helping me improve, however it should sync to your screentime for some goals related to it and it should have some graphics to let you see the long progress
author: nickms pirotecnic

title: Good
body:
I would love some neutral colors for the habit, like black/white/grey.
Also it needs to be able to get track of habits that needs to be done multiple times a day.

Best regards from Italy.
author: Cristian770

title: Apple Watch
body: Please add the Apple Watch app
author: Andreaspace90

title: Ottima app
body:
Migliore app per tracking delle abitudini giornaliere, l’unica senza alcuna pubblicità!
Avrei giusto 2 consigli per migliorare l’esperienza d’uso (che è comunque già ottima):
- aggiungerei la possibilità di marcare un’habit come eseguita direttamente dalla notifica di reminder
- aggiungerei la possibilità di ricevere una notifica di follow up se un habit non viene smarcata entro un tot di tempo dall’orario della notifica di reminder

Grazie dell’ottimo lavoro!
author: Dario Valentini

title: Best habit tracking app
body: This is the only habit tracking app which doesn’t require any expenditure and honestly it’s also a great app. It allows you to do anything the other apps offer and the graphic is smooth. I hope the developer can get the recognition he deserves and I hope this app will never go on the payment route
author: Teoteob05

title: The definitive habit tracker
body:
Great UI, simple and clean. No fuss, no limitations, no distractions. Love it!
Would love to support it and hope it is kept up to date and not forgotten.
author: Wario98

title: Awesome but there are improving margins
body: I really love this app for the style but I would really like to have statistics about the consistency I had with my habits. For instance seeing how well I did in the last month or weeks and so on and so forth.
author: LudoYH

title: Fantastica
body:
Semplice e perfetta!
Sarebbe utile integrare una Dashboard mensile sui progressi
author: Giuseppegg96

title: perfect
body: enables you to do every little action you need. very well planned and designed. clean and minimal! love
author: misil.4

title: Basically the best habit tracker
body:
This app is incredible in its design and functionality. It has all the features I was looking for, and… it’s free. 

There are two suggestions I would share:
1 - give us a way to support you, developer, this is great work;
2 - it would be nice to have double checks for habits due multiple times a day.
author: simonebiraghi

title: Everything is just perfect
body: It’s like 3 different apps in one, you can do everything for free and it works perfectly. The only thing that I’d suggest is a mood tracker in the journaling section if that’s possible 🦭
author: 7_coccobello_7

title: Finally
body: I was looking for a tracking app for my habits since long and I couldn’t find any that wasn’t subscription based also for the most basic things. Finally I found one. Lots of thanks to the developer for this app
author: EVivori

title: Beautiful!
body: Really nice app! It has everything it needs. You should add some widgets (considering the new ios14) tho! That would be nicer!
